profile.headline: Software Engineer at Travelers
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Highly motivated IT professional with more than twenty years experience of project management, system management, technical support and technology training services.  Comprehensive experience in server management, network design and maintenance, workstation engineering, security, and contingency planning.  Thorough knowledge of business processes and exceptional customer relation skills.  Analytical and detail oriented problem solver with written, communication, and interpersonal skills.

positions.title: Learning Facilitator
positions.description: Under general supervision, lead facilitor and project manager for SharePoint 2016 in the IT training department at Travelers.  As a senior training consultant, I deliver instructor led training in person and virtually to employees world wide.  Provide consulting services for all lines of business and SME in knowledge management and custom SharePoint solutions.

positions.title: Information Systems Consultant
positions.description: Technical support for NYC office of over 400 end users including high profile executives.  Point of contact for server and network outages, server backups, shipping and receiving of computer related equipment, new hire setup, and technical documentation.  Provide technical support and administration of workstations, printers, and IP phones.  Business line office liaison for technical requests, challenges, and solutions.  Manage technical instruction of laptop, VPN, Microsoft Office, email, and Lotus Notes training for NYC Travelers employees.

positions.title: Technical Trainer
positions.description: Provide classroom based technical instruction for the Microsoft Office 2010 Suite of applications.  Instruct three hour evening courses in Excel, Word, Power Point, Outlook, and Access 2010.  Develop courseware and exercises for students to learn the material and effectively enhance their skill level in the Microsoft Office products.

positions.title: Trade Floor Technician, Consultant
positions.description: Provided hardware support for the largest trade floor in the World at UBS Investment Bank in Stamford, Connecticut.  Diagnosed and resolved complex technical problems associated with trade floor hardware including workstations, monitors, printers, switches, cabling, and video conferencing equipment.  Performed routine service and repairs on Compaq, Dell, and IBM laptops/workstations and HP LaserJet series printers.

positions.title: Software Deployment Technician, Consultant
positions.description: Responsible for high-volume software installations to remote locations in New York City and throughout the United States due to 911 disaster.  Scheduled software deployments via Systems Management Server (SMS 2.0) and/or remote control software Timbuktu Pro.  Utilized the ticket based Action Request System (Remedy) to manage queue for the distribution of software.  Investigated and verified installation of client software remotely through customer feedback, log files, and Timbuktu Pro.

positions.title: System Administrator, Consultant
positions.description: Performed dedicated SA responsibilities for traders and software developers at JPMorganChase.  Maintained production and development Citrix Servers for remote access to the Kapital application.  Responsible for Citrix Server account maintenance, ICA connections, service packs, security, virus detection, and application maintenance.
